Task List and Capstone Project Requirements

This document consists of the series of tasks that you should complete in your sandbox as part of the certification requirements. All tasks are required unless explicitly marked otherwise. Use this list to keep up with the class, as completing them on time will ensure that you can complete later lessons and will have developed the need to complete the capstone project.

There are three requirements you must complete in order to receive your certification: the task list, the capstone, and the exam. Upon completion of the classes, you will need to acknowledge in JAGGAER University that you have completed a ll essential tasks in the workbook, submit the screenshots of your capstone project, and pass the exam with a score of 80 percent or greater.
